title: [Bug] MCP authentication prompt hangs when pressing enter to continue
body:
**Bug Description**
When authenticating or un-athenticating from MCPs via the /mcp list, the final step where you are prompted to press enter to continue is broken and hangs. This also hapens when when you attempt to unauthenticate from a mcp server. On occasion restarting claude fixes this but I haven't found a way to un-athenticate from an MCP via this path that works yet. 

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: ghostty
- Version: 2.1.90
- Feedback ID: a55f2126-a502-4072-a33d-d5f56ce0dc49

top_comments.body:
# Draft bug report: MCP OAuth "Press Enter to continue" ignores keyboard input

Intended as a follow-up comment on:
- https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/42707 (primary)
- https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/45875 (duplicate family)

---

## Summary

After completing OAuth in the browser for a remote MCP server, the "Press Enter to continue" modal in Claude Code does not respond to Enter, Esc, or any other key. Ctrl+C is the only escape. Reproduces in iTerm2 and Termina

top_comments.body: Pressing tab first then enter works for me
